dedupe_keys.name: microsoft s global building footprints data of portugal

description: Microsoft's Global Building Footprints data of Portugal is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Bruno Barbosa (University of Lisbon). The growth of the Wildland-Urban Interface (WUI) creates a need for accurate mapping to support effective wildfire risk management. One major obstacle is the lack of complete national building footprint databases. Coverage: global (PT); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
